About a year and a half into his second term, President Donald Trump's approval rating among Utah voters continues to be underwater.

A new Deseret News/Hinckley Institute of Politics poll, conducted by Morning Consult, found Utahns generally aren't happy with the way Trump has handled his return to the White House. It's a trend seen in nationwide polling, too, despite the president boasting about positive ratings. [...] Approval is something that Trump clearly wants from the American people. He's posted figures online saying he had a 59% approval rating but no source to back that number up.

National polls in recent months have shown that the president is losing support among younger voters
